cases.question: What is COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture about?
cases.standalone_question: What is COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture about?
cases.answer_excerpt:
COMP 4537 Internet Software Architecture focuses on the design, development, and management of web APIs. 

Key details of the course include:
- **Core Topics:** Explores RESTful APIs, how HTTP and REST APIs relate, CRUD operations, REST constraints, and the use of HTTP status codes.
- **Prerequisites:** COMP 1537 and COMP 3522.
- **Credits:** 3.0 credits.
- **Learning Outcomes:** Students learn to design web services and RESTful APIs, apply best practices and versioning, implement error handling and secure backend servers, and work with technologies like REST, JSON, and HTTP.

cases.question: By how much can BCIT raise domestic tuition each year, and when do the new rates take effect?
cases.standalone_question: By how much can BCIT raise domestic tuition each year, and when do the new rates take effect?
cases.answer_excerpt:
BCIT may raise domestic tuition by up to 2 percent each year, and the new rates take effect on August 1.

Here are the details regarding domestic tuition increases and rates:
- **Annual Increase:** Post-secondary institutions in BC, including BCIT, are permitted to raise domestic tuition by 2 percent annually under the Ministry of Post-Secondary Education and Future Skills’ Tuition Limit Policy.
- **Effective Date:** New tuition rates are posted by BCIT each year in April and officially take effect on August 1. If tuition is paid prior to April using old rates, any difference must be paid within 10 business days from the start of the program.

cases.question: Does BCIT offer on-campus student housing at the Burnaby campus?
cases.standalone_question: Does BCIT offer on-campus student housing at the Burnaby campus?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Yes, BCIT offers on-campus student housing at the Burnaby Campus, featuring over 800 rooms and the Tall Timber Student Housing building.

* **Burnaby Campus Housing:** BCIT provides more than 800 rooms on the Burnaby campus, including legacy Townhouses and the 12-storey Tall Timber Student Housing building, which opened in Fall 2025. 
* **Room Options:** Tall Timber offers fully self-contained studio rooms and connected single rooms, as well as units with shared bathrooms and kitchens. The legacy Townhouses host 12 students each in private rooms with shared common facilities.
* **Eligibility & Applications:** International students accepted into a full-time, cohort-based BCIT program are eligible to apply for Student Housing, with priority access in Tall Timber for Indigenous students and former youth in care. On-campus housing is limited and not guaranteed, so students are encouraged to apply early.

cases.question: Am I automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan, and can I opt out?
cases.standalone_question: Am I automatically enrolled in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan, and can I opt out?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Yes, enrollment in the BCITSA Health and Dental Plan is automatic under certain conditions, and you do have the option to opt out.

- **Automatic Enrollment:** You are automatically enrolled if your program is designated as full-time by BCIT and has a duration of at least 16 weeks. The associated fee will be automatically included in your tuition when you register. 
- **Opting Out:** If you already have comparable extended health and dental benefits coverage, you can choose to opt out of the student plan. The deadline to submit an opt-out is 30 days from the start of your program (once per 12 months). Be aware that after this deadline passes, opt-outs can no longer be processed.

Sources:

- **COMP 4537 (Internet Software Architecture):** Carries 3.0 credits and requires COMP 1537 and COMP 3522 as prerequisites.

cases.answer_excerpt:
You have 30 days from the start of your program to opt out of the student health and dental plan.

- **Deadline:** The opt-out and family add-on window closes strictly 30 days after your program begins.
- **Frequency:** This window occurs once every 12 months.
- **Important Note:** Once this 30-day deadline passes, opt-outs can no longer be processed, so be sure to submit your request on time if you already have comparable coverage.

Pour la Catégorie 2, les scores requis au test TOEFL iBT dépendent de la date :
* **Avant le 21 janvier 2026 :** Un score global de 86 avec aucun score de section inférieur à 20.
